description: This file defines a FastAPI application with a dependency class 'CommonQueryParams' for handling query parameters. It includes an endpoint '/items/' that retrieves and filters items from a mock database using dependency injection.

classes.description: A class encapsulating common query parameters 'q', 'skip', and 'limit' for filtering item queries.

methods.description: Asynchronous endpoint handler that retrieves items from the mock database, filtering based on query parameters provided via dependency injection.
